_strategyNote: The bot row has many columns; contract asserts the ones we actually consume (botid, name, configuration). Others are tenant-specific and non-contractual.
responseShape: { botid, name, configuration, ...plus many non-contractual columns }
knownQuirks: configuration is returned as a JSON STRING in some tenants and a JSON OBJECT in others. Parse defensively: typeof resp.data.configuration === 'string' ? JSON.parse(...) : resp.data.configuration.
Request with $select parameter containing unknown columns returns 400 '0x80060888' with 'Could not find a property named X'. Omit $select or only select known columns.
additionaltokenendpointurl column does NOT exist on bot entity (discovered 2026-04-17). Do not include in $select.
